mapper.select: SELECT cr.*, c.coursename, t.teachername FROM course_resource cr LEFT JOIN course c ON cr.courseid = c.courseid LEFT JOIN teacher t ON cr.teacherid = t.teacherid WHERE cr.courseid = #{courseid} ORDER BY cr.createtime DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{limit}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM course_resource WHERE courseid = #{courseid}
SELECT cr.*, c.coursename, t.teachername FROM course_resource cr LEFT JOIN course c ON cr.courseid = c.courseid LEFT JOIN teacher t ON cr.teacherid = t.teacherid WHERE cr.id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO course_resource (courseid, teacherid, title, description, filetype, filepath, filename, filesize, downloadcount, createtime) VALUES (#{courseid}, #{teacherid}, #{title}, #{description}, #{filetype}, #{filepath}, #{filename}, #{filesize}, 0, #{createtime})
mapper.update: UPDATE course_resource SET downloadcount = downloadcount + 1 WHERE id = #{id}
